messages:
ashley: Quick sync — follow-up on the ACME on‑prem outage postmortem. I pulled out the action items we promised in the doc and wanted owners/timelines.

samir: Thanks. Can we list the high priority ones here? I want to make sure Dedicated infra has owners before EOD.

ashley: Top 3 we flagged: 1) VPC peering flaky route propagation (root cause: AWS route table race during peering swap) -> owner: @samir -> ETA 2 weeks to harden + test; 2) on‑prem NAT/egress policy mismatch causing slow connection tears with our healthcheck -> owner: @mia -> ETA 1 week for mitigation, 3) isolation bug in the agent that allowed cross-tenant socket reuse -> owner: @jgonzalez -> ETA 3 weeks for full fix + rollout gate.

mia: I can take the NAT/egress mitigation. Plan is to ship a stricter conntrack prune in the agent and add a preflight validation to the installer. Quick mitigation: tighten kube-proxy iptables rule for service CIDR until agent fix lands.

samir: For peering: root cause makes sense. Proposal: add an explicit route reconciliation job that runs for 5min after peering events + more conservative retry backoff in our peering controller. I'll open RDW-3412 with details.

jgonzalez: Re: agent isolation bug — I reproduced locally. Patch in progress, adding a per-tenant socket namespace and a unit test. Will also add an e2e that runs within our onprem harness. PR target next Tue.

kelsey: For customer comms, can we get dates for the mitigations? ACME asked for a timeline in the next status update.

ashley: Samir 2 weeks (target 2026-04-08), Mia 1 week (target 2026-03-25), JG Tue PR + 3 weeks to rollout (target 2026-04-15). I'll consolidate into the postmortem and send to ACME. @kelsey please hold the status template ready.

sre-oncall: Adding a monitoring rule suggestion: alert when BGP/peering route convergence > 120s for a given VPC. Also suggest a synthetic test that does a traceroute to a canary IP after peering events.

samir: Good call, will add the alert and synthetic. Also adding a runbook step: if route propagation fails, failover to backup VPC peering (we have one) and notify oncall.

opsbot: New ticket created: RDW-3412 — Peering reconciliation job + retry backoff (assignee: samir).

ashley: Ops timeline check: do we need cross-team support for testing on ACME onprem? We may need their infra team to allow a test window for peering failover simulation.

mia: Yes — I flagged a test window next Wed in the postmortem doc. I'll ping ACME infra to sign off. Also adding a checklist to confirm NAT rules and conntrack table size before/after test.

jgonzalez: For the agent fix I'd like a canary rollout rule: only to Dedicated infra VPCs first, then private clusters. Add automatic rollback if error rate > 0.5% in 10m.

ashley: Agreed. Also another recurring pattern we noticed in the postmortem: whenever we do peering swaps we see peering flaps + control-plane reconnections. Need a longer term item: improve peering controller idempotency and add chaos tests around peering.

samir: Adding long-term ticket RDW-3540: peering controller hardening + chaos tests. Assigning to infra-ctrls squad. ETA Q2.

kelsey: For the status update to ACME, short PR draft: "We identified three issues: route propagation during peering swaps, on‑prem egress policy mismatch, and an agent isolation bug. We have owners, mitigation timelines, and will run a scheduled test with you next week. Full fixes are scoped and scheduled." Want me to send now or after RDW-3412 exists?

ashley: Send after RDW-3412 exists and JG has PR open. I'll review before send.

sre-oncall: One more ops note: add a recurring postmortem pattern tracker (simple spreadsheet) so we can see frequency of peering-related incidents and tie to code rollouts.

ashley: Good idea — @kelsey can you own the tracker and share weekly?

kelsey: Yep, I'll set it up and share a view-only link. Will include columns: incident_id, root_cause_tag, owner, mitigation_date, recurrence_count, customer_impact.

samir: Quick technical note: sample command we'll run for reconciliation smoke test:

```
# run from controller host
curl -XPOST http://localhost:8080/peering/reconcile -d '{"vpc":"vpc-abc123"}'
```

mia: And for the NAT preflight check I'll add this to the installer healthcheck:

```
# verify conntrack entries below threshold
conntrack -S | grep -E "tcp|udp" | wc -l
```

jgonzalez: Will add unit test snippet to PR describing socket namespace validation.

ashley: OK — assign owners in the postmortem doc, set the dates above, and let's reconvene Fri 11am to confirm progress. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

samir: Ack.

mia: Ack.

jgonzalez: Ack.

opsbot: Reminder: weekly incident follow-up scheduled Fri 11:00.
